note: Executable hardware-software pin-map contract consumed by Acadia-OS device trees and Acadia-HAL platform tables. Changes are cross-repo breaking events; bump board_revision on any edit. UART allocation authority: parent doc/uart-allocation.md.

pico_uart.note: HW-004: moved off GPIO14/15 (UART0) — that UART is the OS debug console and HAL's RS-485 port (Acadia-HAL platform_rpi5.h). The Pico W link now uses RP1 UART2 on GPIO0/1, which were previously unallocated. Consuming code resolves the device node through Acadia-HAL's acadia_rs485_uart()/RPI5_UART1 table, not a hard-coded /dev path.

uart.note: Pico W co-processor link (HW-004); UART0 on GPIO14/15 remains the OS debug console and is NOT exposed to modules.

electrical_limits.note: All GPIO are 3.3V logic; do not expose to >3.3V without level shifting.
